description: This Java class 'UnmappedOutboundSignal' represents an outbound signal that has not yet been mapped to an external message. It provides methods to create instances from JSON objects, serialize to JSON, and access internal fields such as source signal and targets. It is part of the connectivity services in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: UnmappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: An immutable class representing an outbound signal that has not yet been mapped to an external message, capable of being serialized to and deserialized from JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create an UnmappedOutboundSignal instance from a JSON object, parsing source signal and targets using provided mapping strategies.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal associated with this outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets associated with this outbound signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this UnmappedOutboundSignal instance to a JSON object, adhering to the specified schema version and predicate.
